Pass & Play: two players, one device

NoCharge V2 Pass & Play is local turn-taking on one shared device. Six current games are listed; each page describes its own controls and handoff behavior.

By NoCharge·Reviewed by NoCharge·Published August 22, 2026·Updated November 24, 2026·2 min read
Check the current platform.

Use the public pages behind this explanation.

Open the ArcadeReview PrivacyKeyboard-only play notes

Bottom line: Pass & Play means two people take turns on the same browser page and device. The current Arcade includes Checkers, Dots & Boxes, Gomoku, Nine Men’s Morris, Pass the Picture, and Reversi in this group.

Turn-taking varies by game

Each game’s status identifies the active player or artist, but there is not one universal “Ready” screen or handoff overlay. The rules, board, and accepted actions differ by title. Open a specific game page before play to check its setup, controls, and end condition.

Local session, not online multiplayer

The current V2 games do not provide online matchmaking, a lobby, player accounts, or cross-device synchronization. The active board or drawing is held in the page session; NoCharge does not provide a saved match record or history dashboard.

These are product boundaries for the current build, not a guarantee that a reload will preserve a game or that every title uses the same handoff pattern.
